title: BiasJailbreak: Analyzing Ethical Biases and Jailbreak Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper centers on evaluating 'ethical biases' in LLMs and their relationship to jailbreak vulnerabilities. The methodology involves benchmarking model responses using keywords associated with marginalized groups, which specifically includes religious categories such as Muslim, Christian, 'Religious minority', and 'Religiously marginalized' groups.
